metadata.title: Gritty Sepia Urban Melancholy Album Cover

retrievalProfile.description: A desaturated, sepia-toned urban scene featuring a solitary figure sitting on the porch of a weathered suburban house, framed by a large evergreen tree and distressed borders.
excludeWhen: clean modern minimalist architecture is requested
cheerful or high-energy moods are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a desaturated, brownish-grey palette. A large, dark evergreen tree occupies the left third, casting a heavy shadow over a man sitting on the steps of a modest, two-story house with horizontal siding. The house is angled toward the right, creating a strong diagonal perspective. The entire image has a grainy, film-like texture with a rough, white-distressed border.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark mass of the tree balances the bright, angled facade of the house.
The solitary figure at the bottom left provides a focal point within the deep shadows.
The typography is anchored in the top right corner, contrasting with the organic shapes below.
The sepia monochromatic tone unifies the disparate elements of nature, architecture, and human presence.
coreInvariants: Rough, distressed white border framing the square image
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows under the porch and tree
Diagonal perspective of the house siding

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small-scale human figure is seated at the bottom left; the house occupies the center and right; a large tree dominates the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, textured mass of the evergreen tree on the left side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark tree, moves down to the seated figure, follows the diagonal lines of the house siding upward to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The pale, overcast sky in the upper right provides breathing room for the display typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sepia-grey (mid-tones of the house and sky)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white (distressed border and highlights on the house)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation; high value contrast between deep shadows and bright sky/siding.

letterConstructionRules: Intentional reversal of specific characters (e.g., the letter E)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The final 'E' in the primary wordmark is mirrored horizontally to face left.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the clear area of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial geometric sans-serif with a loose, organic handwritten subtitle.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric structure for the display text.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Architect's Daughter or similar felt-tip script
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the informal, handwritten look of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, grainy, sepia-toned photograph of a man sitting on the wooden steps of a weathered suburban house with horizontal siding. A large, dark evergreen tree should be on the left. The sky should be a pale, flat grey-brown. Apply a rough, white distressed border around the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner in dark charcoal. Mirror the final 'E' so it faces left. Below it, add a line of small, widely-spaced handwritten uppercase text.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia/monochromatic?
Is the final 'E' in the main title mirrored?
Is there a distressed white border around the image?
Is the figure positioned in the lower-left shadow area?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distressing on the border
postGenerationChecks: Check that the mirrored 'E' is present and legible.
Ensure the grain texture is visible across the entire image.
Verify the border looks like worn paper or film edges.
Confirm the text is aligned to the right and does not overlap the tree.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Melancholy = (Sepia Tone + Grain) * (Suburban Decay + Solitary Figure) + (Geometric Typography with Mirrored Elements)
